title: Notif Notifs Model
description: Information about a specific notification target of the device.

units.description: Expected unit configuration for the notification target

type.description: Expected data type for the notification target

description.description: Detailed description of this notification target

writable.description: Indicates if this notification target is writable (else read-only)

baseline_value.description: Represents the expected baseline value of the notification target

baseline_state.description: Expected state when `baseline_value` is set as the `set_value` in the config message

range_min.description: Represents the lower bound of the error threshold

range_max.description: Represents the upper bound of the error threshold

unchanged_limit_sec.description: Represents the limit in seconds that the target can be unchanged for

cov_increment.description: Triggering threshold for partial cov update publishing

ref.description: Mapping for the notification target to an internal resource (e.g. BACnet object reference)

tags.description: Tags associated with the notification target
